prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: The prime minister addressed (A) / the nation from the ramparts (B) / of the Red Fort last morning. (C) / No Error (D)
options: of the Red Fort last morning.
explanation: 'Last morning' is not idiomatic English; the correct expression is 'yesterday morning' (we say last night/week/month, but yesterday morning/afternoon/evening).
